configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.displayName: Release (Linux and macOS, warnings as errors)
configurePresets.description: The lane linux-ci.yml and macos-ci.yml build and test, and what scripts/build.sh and scripts/ci-local.sh run. Warnings-as-errors lives here (not in CMakeLists.txt) so a casual `cmake -S . -B build` stays friendly while every preset user gets CI's verdict. Linux and macOS share it because their toolchain is the host's own compiler.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.displayName: Debug (Linux and macOS, warnings as errors)
configurePresets.description: Local-dev debug variant of release. Not a CI lane.

configurePresets.name: package
configurePresets.displayName: Package (Release, warnings as errors, the shipped artifacts)
configurePresets.description: What the release builds ship from and what the pull-request package lanes build: the .deb and .rpm (scripts/build-deb.sh, scripts/build-rpm.sh), the AppImage (scripts/build-appimage.sh) and the macOS bundle (scripts/package-macos.sh). The release flags and warnings-as-errors of the release preset, in its own tree so a package build never clobbers build/. The scripts add -DSATELLITE_RELEASE_VERSION and -DSATELLITE_SENTRY_DSN.

configurePresets.name: windows-mingw
configurePresets.description: The lane windows-ci.yml builds and tests: MSYS2 MINGW64 gcc via MinGW Makefiles. Warnings-as-errors matches the linux/macos lanes; MSYS2 is rolling, so the gcc is whatever MINGW64 ships at job time. Needs C:\msys64\mingw64\bin on PATH (scripts/install-deps.ps1).

configurePresets.name: windows-mingw-debug
configurePresets.description: Local-dev debug variant of windows-mingw. Not a CI lane.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: MSVC build that unlocks /guard:cf (CFG) + /CETCOMPAT (CET shadow stack) + /Qspectre. libsodium, openssl, opus and sentry-native come from vcpkg's static triplet at vcpkg.json's builtin-baseline so their CRT linkage matches the app's /MT. Warnings-as-errors (/WX) as on every other lane. Requires VCPKG_ROOT in the environment (scripts/setup-vcpkg.ps1 checks vcpkg out at the baseline). The generator below is the default; CI and scripts/build.ps1 override it per machine with `-G $(scripts/windows-vs-generator.ps1)`.
